text: Visual dialogue refers to the task in which an artificial agent and a human hold a meaningful and coherent conversation that is grounded in visual input [ 1 ]. Typically, an agent needs to answer a sequence of questions about a given image, where the questions can only be understood in relation to previous question-answer pairs. In many respects, the task of visual dialogue is similar to the task of visual question answering [ 2 ], with the additional difficulty that the question-answer pairs are not independent from each other.
source_label: Neuro-symbolic procedural semantics for explainable visual dialogue
